idea_name: PnF classic pattern breakout change signals
mechanism: On the PnF column grid, detect Double Top (new X column exceeds prior X high by ≥1 box → buy), Double Bottom (new O exceeds prior O low by ≥1 box → sell), Triple Top/Bottom (third touch then break), Symmetrical Triangle upside/downside breakouts, Bullish/Bearish Catapult breaks of the flat side, and 45-degree trend-line breaks; each maps to a discrete change event.
data_needed: Completed PnF column open/close levels; box grid; pattern matchers on successive X/O columns
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same EURUSD PnF from M1; illustrated on Daily chart objects
why_new_for_mis: Converts classic PnF breakout geometries into explicit regime-change event codes MIS can fuse with other sensors, keyed to box-scaled structure rather than calendar bars.
quote: "Double Top" occurs when the price goes up, then falls forming a certain column of O's and rises again, exceeding the previous column of X's by one Box Size. This pattern is a buy signal.

idea_name: Sub-box M1 noise ignore and box-size volatility gate
mechanism: While building PnF, ignore price moves that are not more than ~50% of Box Size relative to the last drawn box price; only commit new boxes when |Δprice|/Tick ≥ Cell. Recalculate the whole chart when |OldPrice-close[0]|/Tick > Cell. Box Size itself is the volatility quantization unit (author notes arrow-style plotting would need volatility-aware buffer counts).
data_needed: Tick size; Cell; last box price BeginPrice/OldPrice; M1 opens
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: M1 feed into PnF; EURUSD; author notes typical M1 moves of 2–6 points
why_new_for_mis: Supplies MIS a simple volatility/noise gate: amplitude below a configured box fraction is discarded, and box size becomes an explicit volatility scale for structure sensors.
quote: in case of price reversal, the calculation will be based on the price of the last symbol, rather than the highest price of the pair. In other words, if the price movement is not more than 50% of the Box Size, it is simply ignored.

idea_name: MACD DiffMain zero-side momentum growth/fall model
mechanism: Custom CSignalMyCustInd on Examples\MACD: DiffMain(ind)=Main(ind)-Main(ind+1). LongCondition if DiffMain>0 (main line rising) with optional Model 1 requiring DiffMain(ind+1)<0 (turn up); ShortCondition if DiffMain<0 with optional prior DiffMain>0 turn down. Intended narrative: MACD below zero and rising → expect growth; above zero and falling → expect decline (zero-side context for the custom model).
data_needed: CiCustom MACD buffers Main/Signal; PeriodFast/Slow/Signal; IS_PATTERN_USAGE(0/1); StartIndex bars

idea_name: Model-0 confirming filter keeps pending orders alive with oscillator direction

idea_name: Prior-bar direction pullback with dynamic pending PriceLevel
mechanism: On D1 Envelopes signal module: if prior bar close<open (bearish) LongCondition sets Buy Stop; if close>open ShortCondition sets Sell Stop.
